name: Medina
scopeLimits: The UN WUP 2025 point is a settlement-population locator, not an official city boundary, property identity, or completeness statement. No owner, address, applicant, or tax data was requested or retained; no account credentials, CAPTCHA, or token was used. The municipal GeoPortal advertises land parcels, but the ArcGIS land feature layer returned HTTP 499 Token Required to anonymous metadata requests. No token or authenticated path was used.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Medina Municipality’s official GeoPortal announcement lists approved land parcels, land-use and plan layers as part of its municipal geospatial information. The advertised ArcGIS land layer is not anonymously inspectable: direct REST metadata calls returned HTTP 499 Token Required.

officialSources.observation: Official 2024 announcement describes the public GeoPortal, including approved land parcels, land uses, residential plan boundaries and city urban extent.
Official portal provides geospatial and municipal information and map browsing for users; its advertised parcel layer could not be anonymously queried through the underlying REST layer.
Municipal survey-decision service card requires sign-in via national single sign-on; it is a separate administrative service and not used for geometry access.
Layer metadata identifies a land parcel layer, but anonymous REST requests returned HTTP 499 Token Required; no request was made with a token.

requests.observation: Anonymous MapServer metadata request returned Token Required.
Anonymous request to the advertised land layer returned Token Required. No feature query or token use followed.
Official GeoPortal page advertises municipal geospatial information. Public bundles inspected did not reveal an anonymous parcel-vector route.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Municipal GeoPortal advertising and layer metadata discovery only; anonymous layer metadata is token-gated and no feature geometry was returned.

research.technicalBlocker: The candidate municipal ArcGIS layer requires a token even for anonymous REST metadata retrieval (HTTP 499). No token was sought, reused or stored.
research.remainingUncertainty: Whether the GeoPortal has a separate anonymous vector endpoint for approved land parcels, and whether any anonymous feature query would be permitted.

technicalBlocker: The official municipal GeoPortal advertises parcel layers, but its ArcGIS REST service rejects anonymous metadata requests with 499 Token Required.
remainingUncertainty: A separate unauthenticated public full-polygon layer may exist but was not identified.
nextStep: If revisited, locate a separately documented anonymous official vector service; do not attempt to obtain or reuse an authentication token.
